lot_cases.sql: SELECT parcel_id, address_full, zone_d, coverage_frac FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.parcel_id) p.parcel_id, ap.address_full, (regexp_match(p.zoning_zn_string, '[(; ]d([0-9.]+)'))[1]::numeric AS zone_d, p.bylaw_max_coverage_pct / 100.0 AS coverage_frac FROM parcels p JOIN parcel_address_points pap ON pap.parcel_id = p.id JOIN address_points ap ON ap.address_point_id = pap.address_point_id AND ap.retired_at IS NULL WHERE p.zoning_class IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.parcel_id, ap.address_full) s ORDER BY md5(parcel_id || $1) LIMIT $2
lot_cases.sql_counting: SELECT parcel_id, address_full, zone_d, coverage_frac FROM (SELECT DISTINCT ON (p.parcel_id) p.parcel_id, ap.address_full, (regexp_match(p.zoning_zn_string, '[(; ]d([0-9.]+)'))[1]::numeric AS zone_d, p.bylaw_max_coverage_pct / 100.0 AS coverage_frac FROM parcels p JOIN parcel_address_points pap ON pap.parcel_id = p.id JOIN address_points ap ON ap.address_point_id = pap.address_point_id AND ap.retired_at IS NULL WHERE p.zoning_class IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM parcel_maxbld_scenarios s WHERE s.parcel_id = p.id AND s.status = 'computed' AND s.value IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY p.parcel_id, ap.address_full) s ORDER BY md5(parcel_id || $1) LIMIT $2
lot_cases.sql_counting_note: 2026-11-13 (MF-81 follow-up): the drills and the stress runner sample these lots, those with a stored Layer 3 row that is computed with a value (the 1,921-lot cohort in parcel_maxbld_scenarios), because the meter counts only a lot with an evaluated option (Spec 100 3.2 dated note 2026-11-12, EI-D1 '1 b'; route hasEvaluatedOption). The lot sweep keeps the plain sql. Read-only.
